spec_basis: docs/type-directed-optimization-plan.md §三 (effect table + kill rows), §四 (PERF-SHAPE-ID dual-domain), §6.2 (T-spike mandatory verification gate)
docs/process-model-design.md §20.2a typed 追加 ①② (unsound guard elision forbidden; polymorphic arm mandatory)
scope: 2-3 day vertical prototype: hand-prebuilt shape registry + specialized typed slot access; no compiler pipeline, no F3/F5 ingestion

arms.stress: polymorphic arm: alternating two-subclass call sites with sliding-window (not consecutive-fail) invalidation — mandatory per ledger §20.2a ②

target_workloads.primary: hand-built typed property-dense fixed-work microbench (pdfjs/typescript/box2d access shapes)
target_workloads.controls: untyped equivalents of the same loops (specialization must not tax the untyped path)

primary_metric: paired fixed-work time ratio, own-slot form, property-dense typed microbench (candidate/baseline; insn and cycles recorded together)

minimum_effect.own_slot: +8% on the property-dense typed microbench, in at least one guard arm
minimum_effect.basis: doc (typed plan §三 kill row: < +8% ⇒ 静态属性赌注死)

correctness_gates: zig build test, zig build smoke
test262 subset covering property semantics touched by the prototype

NO guard-free own-slot access anywhere in the prototype: untyped-alias delete makes guard elision a memory-safety defect (ledger §20.2a ①); auto-seal vs guard is a T-gate-0 ruling, not a spike shortcut

size_cost_limit.basis: doc (2-3 天垂直原型); hard stop proposed

sample_protocol: measurement contract (tools/compare/measurement_policy.json sha256 020f2f18...); >=8 paired ABBA samples, pinned big core, CV <= 5% or lengthen workload; insn+cycles same run

verdicts.pass: own-slot >= +8% in >=1 guard arm AND polymorphic arm does not collapse the win AND untyped controls within noise -> evidence supports G1-TYPED=implement; report which guard domain won where (feeds PERF-SHAPE-ID dual-domain contract)
verdicts.redesign: the +8% is reachable only by violating a v1 constraint (e.g. only unsound guard elision clears it, or proto-slot/polymorphic pathology contradicts the S3 workload) -> respec before G1-TYPED rules
verdicts.fail: own-slot < +8% in every sound arm -> static-property bet dead; interpreter-level static axis shrinks to typed FFI + backend-input value; PERF-TYPED-IR still ruled by its dual trigger (typed plan §5.1)
